notes: Behavior evals for the gates. Evals 1 and 2 are runnable as `claude plugin eval` cases (plugins/ugt-nextjs-platform/evals/system-test-no-docker and system-test-live-gates) — they need no Docker and no network: the point is that the agent STOPS. Both are tagged `needs-shell`: the agent must run `docker info` / `node env-ready.mjs`, and `claude plugin eval` on Windows gives the agent no Bash (no sandbox backend) — run them where the eval sandbox has a shell (Linux/macOS/WSL), and `system-test-no-docker` only where Docker is absent from that sandbox. Eval 3 needs a machine with Docker and a project that finished full-setup; it is graded by hand from the transcript + `docker compose ps`. Prompts are Thai on purpose: they are what org users type.

baseline_result.note: pending — run at the next release gate

evals.name: no-docker-stops
evals.prompt: ทดสอบระบบใน container ให้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: Checks `docker info` only · Docker missing → tells the user to install Docker Desktop / Rancher Desktop / Podman and call the skill again · stops: no LocalDB, no TCP proxy, no local SQL Server search, no npm run dev against a stand-in, no edit to .env.local
assertions: The only machine check is `docker info` (or `docker version`) — no sqllocaldb, no service listing, no port scan
The reply names Docker Desktop (or Rancher Desktop / Podman) as the prerequisite
No file under the project is written or edited
No test step is attempted after Docker is found missing

evals.name: live-refuses-unready-env
evals.prompt: admin ทำตาม admin-handoff เสร็จแล้ว ทดสอบทั้งระบบได้เลย
evals.expected_output: Picks live mode from the user's words without asking the mode question · runs scripts/env-ready.mjs · it exits 1 (CHANGE_ME left, prod basePath) → reports the ✘ lines and where each value comes from (docs/admin-handoff.md → .env.local) · stops: does not open the app, does not edit .env.local
assertions: env-ready.mjs runs before any page is opened or server started
The reply lists the failing keys (KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET placeholder, prod basePath)
No dev server is started and no browser page is opened

evals.name: container-full-run
evals.prompt: ทดสอบใน container ตอนนี้เลย
evals.expected_output: docker info OK → installs docker-compose.smoke.yml + smoke/realm-smoke.json + the launch.json `smoke` config, trimmed to the installed modules · `up -d --build` in the background · waits for /api/health and Keycloak discovery · smoke-admin takes /admin/setup, assigns roles to smoke-user1..3 · walks the checklist with evidence · reports PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED before fixing anything · asks which FAIL to fix · tears down with `down -v` or tells the user the command
assertions: The compose file has no line for a module the project did not install
The report table comes before the first code edit
Every checklist line carries PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED with what was seen
The stack is torn down or the user is told the `down -v` command
